name: intentrax-execution-assurance
description: Decide when an AI agent's action deserves a verifiable proof, find those actions in a codebase, wire Intentrax admission -> execution -> verification, and check proofs without overstating them.

interface.shortDescription: Verifiable proof for consequential agent actions
interface.longDescription: Helps you decide when an AI agent's action deserves a verifiable proof, find consequential agent actions in a codebase, propose an integration plan for your approval, wire fail-closed admission -> execution -> verification with the Intentrax SDK, and check proofs honestly. Skills only: the plugin itself runs nothing. Production Intentrax proofs are signed decision records; they do not independently confirm a real-world effect.
capabilities: Plan and wire admission, execution and verification
Write a report-only assurance gap assessment
Check proofs and report verdicts honestly
defaultPrompt: Find the consequential actions my agent takes in this repo and tell me which deserve a proof.
Write a report-only assurance gap assessment for this codebase.
Check this Intentrax proof and tell me exactly what it establishes.

publication.release_notes: Three skills: intentrax-execution-assurance, intentrax-integrate-agent-actions (with a report-only gap mode), and intentrax-verify-proof.
